provenance.prompt: JOEDESIGN으로 현재 Research Briefing Portal의 승인된 Product Truth와 디자인 방향을 유지하면서 reference-a.md와 reference-b.md를 검토해 필요한 관계를 현재 화면에 번역하고 bounded proof를 만들어줘. Desktop 1440×1000 / mobile 390×844 before/after를 실제 확인하고 채택 판단과 관찰 결과를 artifacts에 간단히 남겨줘.

target.state: single initial static screen with one in-page anchor
target.images: Actual full-page browser PNGs; viewport dimensions are not screenshot document heights.

productTruth.title: Shared spaces, stronger daily routines.
productTruth.lead: Three research notes on how shared neighborhood spaces support everyday reading, learning, and connection.

records.title: Later hours, easier access
records.description: Evening library sessions gave participants more ways to fit reading into their working week.

records.title: A place to pause and read
records.description: Small neighborhood reading areas supported short, repeat visits close to daily routes.

records.title: Rooms that welcome more people
records.description: Clear entrances and adaptable shared rooms helped participants join community learning activities.

productTruth.invariants: Required title/action, all three exact record payloads with source/date, meaning/order and desktop/mobile availability preserved.

referenceA.evidence: strong for the provided relationships only; not a quality/taste score or a retrieved website
referenceA.why: Compatible with approved calm editorial hierarchy, primary focal point and restrained surfaces.

referenceB.evidence: supported for provided relationships; trust is separate from project suitability
referenceB.conflict: Dense modular card grid and repeated boxed composition conflict materially with APPROVED DESIGN.md's no-card-wall rule; explicitly rejected before implementation.
boundedTake: source/date proximity inside each record only
referenceB.why: Internal metadata association is compatible independent of the rejected overall composition.

projectSpecificDecisions.authority: project-specific JOEDESIGN decisions, NOT recovered reference facts or new approval
projectSpecificDecisions.font: Existing local Arial retained; source family remains unknown.
projectSpecificDecisions.typography: 64px desktop / 40px mobile primary title; 24px section / 20px record / 16px body / 14px metadata / 12px existing ID label; 400/700 weights.
projectSpecificDecisions.spacing: 4/8/16/24/48px semantic roles; 24px mobile gutters; 16px desktop metadata gap and 4px mobile stack gap.
projectSpecificDecisions.responsive: Existing semantic order retained; local 900/600px breakpoint choices collapse editorial columns, omit aria-hidden decoration, stack record identity/metadata. Mobile title uses normal wrapping after observing an isolated word.
projectSpecificDecisions.motion: No new motion; source timing remains unknown.

beforeAfterObservations.desktop: Before: 26px title near 24px section scale, text/mark stacked, metadata at far edges. Final: 64px primary title, asymmetric hero, left summary label and open ordered records, compact source/date groups.
beforeAfterObservations.mobile: Before: 26px title, visible auxiliary mark, source/date across the row. Final: 40px title reads Shared spaces, / stronger daily / routines.; decorative mark omitted, existing IDs and metadata stacked; all records visible by scrolling. Full-page height grows 1216→1300px.
beforeAfterObservations.localIteration: First after-mobile isolated 'stronger' under balanced wrapping. Native runtime inspected it, retained iteration-1-mobile.png, changed only mobile wrap, then rendered/inspected final. One fresh Smoke E run, not a repeated model run.

checks.expected: Both materially adopted references need source, quality, known, unknown, take, doNotTake, why and scope.
checks.observed: Native proof.md records all eight fields before the implementation edit, only for the two supplied references.
A exact font family/mobile spacing/motion and B responsive order/exact spacing remain UNKNOWN in the native adoption record and final boundary.

checks.expected: A may inform hierarchy without copying an unsupported source design.
checks.observed: Actual desktop has a 64px two-line headline versus 16px body, asymmetric text/quiet-mark spacing, and an open ordered summary list; mobile has a 40px three-line title.

checks.expected: B dense card-grid must be explicitly rejected against approved authority.
checks.observed: Before rendering, runtime names the conflict with APPROVED DESIGN and excludes the card grid and repeated boxes. Final renders have no repeated boxed-card wall.

checks.expected: B compact metadata grouping may apply only inside each record.
checks.observed: Three desktop source/date pairs have a 16px horizontal gap; mobile source/date pairs stack with a 4px vertical gap. B is not applied to the overall composition.

checks.expected: Do not average A and B into a generic hybrid.
checks.observed: A controls editorial hierarchy and open grouping; B only source/time proximity. Actual renders show an open editorial list, not an averaged card-grid composition.

checks.expected: Fixed content, record order, sources/dates and action remain; approval authority is unchanged.
checks.observed: Independent browser readback matches title, lead, headings, record payloads/order and one #research-summary anchor at both targets; immutable authority/input bytes match. Existing Product record IDs become visible labels; whole-body string equality is false and preserved separately.

checks.expected: Needed exact layout values must be project decisions, not fabricated reference facts.
checks.observed: Native pre-render record labels Arial, 64/40px title roles, semantic spacing and breakpoint translation as project judgments rather than extracted source values; introduces no motion.

checks.expected: Observe actual desktop and mobile before and final after, bound material claims to expected → observed → verdict.
checks.observed: Native image-tool calls cover before, first after, corrected final after and focus crops. Controller opened all four final before/after PNGs and independently inspected the two source states in Chrome. No overflow or hidden required content at either target.

checks.expected: Visual conformance is not user acceptance.
checks.observed: Native proof limits Technical/Product/Visual PASS to the two exact static targets and anchor/focus; new-render User Acceptance remains unconfirmed and APPROVED Rev 1 is not promoted.

acceptanceBoundary.technical: PASS for named static browser targets and anchor/focus only
acceptanceBoundary.productConformance: PASS for fixed Product Truth, not identical whole-body text
acceptanceBoundary.visualConformance: PASS for named actual rendered relationships

limitations: No live reference website, exact source CSS, font, responsive tokens or motion evidence was supplied; stipulated evidence labels cover relationship briefs only.
One neutral static fixture and two Chrome viewports are not comparative quality, cross-browser, full accessibility, motion, state coverage or competition-readiness proof.
Full repository readiness remains NOT_READY because test 16 fails independently.
